gaps.explanation: Statement (trimmed p5, GAAP modified accrual, Governmental Funds) total revenues 7,595,438. detail[] uses the Budgetary Comparison Schedules (pp13-16, budgetary basis 'Resources (inflows)') for four funds plus the nonmajor combining statement (p17). Per fund, statement column vs printed schedule total: General 5,220,372 vs 5,185,356 (p13) = +35,016; Street 1,122,804 vs 1,120,758 (p14) = +2,046; LB840 371,371 vs 535,977 (p15; includes budgetary 'Other income' 164,606 not in GAAP revenues) = -164,606; Debt Service 191,763 vs 204,900 (p16) = -13,137; Other Governmental Funds 689,128 = nonmajor 591,596 + 375 + 24,850 + 52,352 + 19,955 (p17) = 0. Sum 35,016 + 2,046 - 164,606 - 13,137 = -140,681 = gap. All four differences are budgetary-basis actuals vs GAAP; no missing or duplicate lines.

Statement (trimmed p5) total expenditures 6,602,940 vs schedules. Per fund: General 4,682,655 vs 4,674,988 (p13 total charges to appropriations) = +7,667; Street 1,406,697 vs 1,418,652 (p14) = -11,955; LB840 13,054 vs 313,070 (p15) = -300,016; Debt Service 378,275 vs 380,099 (p16) = -1,824; Other Governmental Funds 122,259 = nonmajor 89,477 + 6,280 + 20,108 + 6,394 (p17) = 0. Sum 7,667 - 11,955 - 300,016 - 1,824 = -306,128 = gap. Budgetary-basis charges to appropriations vs GAAP expenditures; no missing or duplicate lines.
